Welcome to the Piedmont Center for the Arts

Piedmont Post · October 7, 2026 · 3 min read

Ongoing through November 1

Oakland Art Association gallery show

Oakland Art Association presents Hopes and Dreams — a curated show that encompasses everyone’s most precious and intimate desires for the future. It can be a dream vacation, a dream come true, a dream for the future of the world or just your part of it. Hope knows no bounds: hope for change, for healing, a brighter future, or for world peace. OAA is a nonprofit group of artists, photographers, and art supporters in Alameda and Contra Costa Counties whose mission is to encourage artistic endeavor in the community, support public school art education, and arrange show venues for our members’ artworks. Free and open to all! For more information, see www.oaklandart.org. Gallery is open and staffed Saturdays and Sundays from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m.

Friday, October 9, 6:00 p.m.

Michael Stehr Art History Lecture

A Friday night Extravaganza! Art historian Michael Stehr presents a spirited, illustrated 50-minute lecture exploring Michelangelo’s work in his hometown of Florence, Italy. At the age of 29, he would put the finishing touches on his David, likely one of the most recognizable sculptures in Western Art. As he moved through his forties, this sculptor, painter, architect, and poet of the High Renaissance would continue to yield sculptural masterpieces and explore the art of architecture at San Lorenzo, the parish church of the Medici family. In 1534, he moved to Rome and only returned to Florence after his passing almost another thirty years later. Doors open at 5:30 p.m. $20 (cash only).

Saturday, October 10, 7:00 p.m.

Virginia Tichenor’s Ragtime Quartet Concert

This quartet features ragtime pianist Virginia Tichenor with a stellar line-up of musicians performing ragtime and traditional jazz music. The quartet includes Virginia, of course; Ryan Calloway, clarinet, banjo and vocals; Marty Eggers, tuba; and Robert Young, cornet. Virginia Tichenor is an Oakland-based pianist, originally from St. Louis, MO, the daughter of the late Trebor Tichenor, a noted scholar, pianist and collector of ragtime music. Virginia plays solo piano locally in the Bay Area and is also a traditional jazz pianist, working currently with her husband, Marty Eggers, who also plays with the Zenith, Silver Bell, and Barrelhouse Jazz Bands. Advance tickets are highly recommended for this show, and available now at https://www.ticketsignup.io/Ragtime.

Sunday, October 11, 4:30 p.m.

In the Tradition Jazz & Pop Piano Trio

The In the Tradition Piano Trio – Bill Jackman, Mark Williams, and Albert Brooks – will pay tribute to Jimmy Van Heusen, who composed nearly 1,000 songs between 1930 and 1970, of which 50 or more have become American standards. Don’t miss the relaxed pleasure of an afternoon in the Classic Jazz Club with the trio. Tickets $25 + fee at https://www.tick-etsignup.io/JVH, or $30 at the door. Doors open at 4:15 PM.

Friday, October 16, 7:00 p.m.

String, Skin, & Breath Band Concert

String, Skin, & Breath creates contemporary chamber music rooted in global traditions, blending ancient musical languages with modern expression. Drawing from Latin and North African modes, Ethio-jazz, desert blues, and global folk traditions, the ensemble weaves hypnotic rhythms, spacious improvisation, and rich acoustic textures into immersive performances that feel both timeless and new. The group exists to create a space for spontaneous, deep-listening musical conversation across cultures—stripping music down to its most elemental ingredients, honoring rhythm, vibration, and breath as the shared language beneath every tradition. The intention is to craft unrepeatable performances that move fluidly between meditative stillness and intricate rhythmic interplay, guided by trust and collective intuition rather than rigid arrangement— treating music-making itself as an act of human connection and cross-cultural dialogue. The band includes Uzbek-American cellist Misha Khalikulov, Latin-Grammy-nominated multi-instrumentalist Daniel Riera, percussionist/educator Aaron Kierbel, and Tunisian qanun virtuoso Arslen Metouii. Tickets available at https://www.ticketsignup.io/SSB.

801 Magnolia Avenue • Piedmont, Calif.
